name: Massive
tagline: Market data API for stocks, options, forex, and crypto (ex-Polygon)
description: Massive (formerly Polygon.io) provides real-time and historical market data APIs covering US stocks, options, forex, and cryptocurrencies. Developers use REST and WebSocket endpoints for quotes, trades, aggregates, and reference data with API-key authentication.

auth.details: API key via query parameter or Authorization header; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Stocks Basic (free): 5 API calls/minute; end-of-day US stocks; 2 years historical data. Options/forex/crypto free tiers exist with plan-specific limits (typically 5 calls/min, end-of-day).

rate_limits: Stocks Basic: 5 API calls/minute; paid individual Stocks plans (Starter/Developer/Advanced): unlimited API calls (fair-use; recommend staying under 100 req/s). Other asset-class free tiers also 5/min; paid tiers unlimited.
use_cases: get previous day OHLC for a stock ticker
fetch historical aggregate bars for a symbol
